🔥 The fire settles. Owen has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you — I put it down today." "It crouches low, tail lashing once, twice. The stripes go still. Then it comes." "A paw rises, claws out — casual, almost lazy. It is not lazy." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once.
